race.comment: READY FOR AIMEE (9) gets top billing after saluting as favourite at the midweeks. Her record at this track and distance is a major asset, and she has again drawn to get every chance with 2kg claimer Bella Youngberry retaining the ride. SMOKE ON THE WATER (3) is the clear danger on winning form, having taken a BM70 at the Sunny Coast before repeating the dose at Doomben, with Michael Rodd unbeaten on him. The heavy track is the one variable in an otherwise strong profile. DO IT FOR YOU (4) appeals as the value runner after a good effort to grab fourth in the Lismore Cup behind a couple of handy ones, and his wet-track record gives him the grounding to lift in this company. MUSIC FEVER (5) has won both runs this campaign, including a CL4 at Ipswich, and while this is a stronger meeting, her winning habit keeps her right in the mix. Hampson's 3kg claim also gets her in nice and light. INFLUENTIAL (2) is building nicely into this prep and can also play a role.
